title: The Afternoon Nap (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 96bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist family Perth garden
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The afternoon nap is a practice that requires no defence
But receives more justification than any choice in any tense
You sit down for a moment and the moment becomes twenty
And you wake with a resolution and a sense there's more than plenty

[Pre-Chorus]
I resisted the afternoon nap until I was in my fifties
And then I accepted it the way you accept all the fifties

[Chorus]
The afternoon nap knows something I don't know
It knows the brain reset that happens in the quarter hour below
The afternoon nap is not laziness — that's not the right address
It's maintenance of the instrument — that's the correct process
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The Spanish call it siesta and have organised their whole
National afternoon around the principle that the soul
Requires a pause of twenty minutes in the heat of two
And the afternoon nap says the Spanish have always understood you

[Bridge]
Wilma naps in the chair in the garden on the summer afternoon
And wakes up knowing something she didn't know before the tune
The garden told her something in the twenty minutes she was there
The afternoon nap is where the garden and the mind compare

[Outro]
Afternoon nap knows… the reset is the work… afternoon nap knows
That's my boy
